description: This file defines a PHP class 'aowTemplateParser' that extends 'templateParser'. It provides a static method 'parse_template' for processing template strings by replacing placeholders with data from various beans, particularly handling 'Person' instances specially. It is part of the SuiteCRM project and extends template parsing capabilities with custom logic for beans.

classes.name: aowTemplateParser
classes.description: A class extending templateParser to add custom template parsing logic, especially for 'Person' beans.

methods.name: parse_template
methods.description: Static method that parses a template string by replacing placeholders with bean data, handling multiple beans and specific 'Person' instances.
